changes: Reference model and weight list lengths must match and be nonempty.
Weights must be nonnegative and have positive total; they are normalized explicitly.
Mixture probability must normalize within 1e-12 or fail closed.
Reference objective uses equal weights for the actual size of the full reference bank, rather than a hard-coded two-weight tuple.
New regression test verifies a larger bank changes prediction distribution and malformed weight length fails.
result_interpretation: The corrected helper produces slight floating-point differences in AUC versus the prior artifact, while the qualitative dual-objective trade-off and actuator-misspecification regression remain. The prior artifact remains a valid record of the earlier source revision; the attached fixed artifact binds this corrected revision.
remote_ci: Not claimed; local exact-source tests are independent of GitHub Actions.
